test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many teams were scheduled to be a part of the 15th edition of the Indian Premier League (Cricket), 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **'10'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** 10 teams** are scheduled to play in the **15th edition** of the **Indian Premier League, in 2022.**
 
• In this edition**, Gujrat Titans defeated Rajasthan Royals by 7 wickets.**
 
• CVC Captain partners own the franchise. 
 
• The team played under the captaincy of** Hardik Pandey** and was coached by **Ashish Nehra**.
 
• It was the maiden IPL for Gujrat Titans.
 
• The final match took place at **Narendra Modi Stadium**, in **Ahmedabad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tata Group **was declared the **official sponsor **of the Indian Premier League, 2022.
 
• Tata Group will also be the** title sponsor of IPL, 2023.**
